subject.title: docs(onboarding): finalize phase status and phase 7 decision

question: Should the onboarding plan record CLI-side auto-doctor as the recommended phase-7 direction while leaving gateway minimal-surface mode explicitly unapproved pending owner and security review?
rationale: The patch does not implement either option, but it establishes the decision framing that future onboarding work will follow; the protected `maintainer` label requires an explicit human judgment.

options.title: Confirm the decision memo
options.body: Merge the documentation with CLI-side auto-doctor recorded as the recommended path and gateway minimal-surface mode retained as an owner/security-reviewed alternative.

options.title: Keep phase 7 neutral
options.body: Revise the plan to describe both approaches without recommending one until the responsible owner records a product decision.

recommendation.title: Confirm the decision memo
recommendation.body: Merge the documentation with CLI-side auto-doctor recorded as the recommended path and gateway minimal-surface mode retained as an owner/security-reviewed alternative.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the available routing candidate for the onboarding-plan decision memo and its reconciled phase status.
